name: Mayotte
summary_text: Mayotte: French law nominally applies but the most conservative social environment of the overseas departments; protections largely ineffective in practice. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.14. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to Mayotte as a French overseas department applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in Mayotte): serious violations persist across places of detention.

sources.title: Transsexuels : simplification du changement d’état civil votée par l’Assemblée nationale
sources.claim_summary: LINFO.re (May 2016, in French): the French National Assembly approved simplifying legal gender change (Justice for the 21st Century bill) - the person may demonstrate before a prosecutor that they 'feel themselves to be another sex and that society regards them as such'; French law applies in Mayotte.

sources.title: Couple's struggle exposes anti-LGBT bias on French island Mayotte in Indian Ocean
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (May 2023): a couple's struggle exposes anti-LGBT bias on Mayotte - same-sex marriage is legal (a rarity in Africa and the Islamic world) but Bruno Agar's path to marrying his Malagasy partner was 'long and complicated', illustrating the gap between French legal rights and lived reality in the predominantly Muslim island.
Gayther LGBTQIA+ travel guide for Mayotte (2025 edition) - travel and country information for LGBT visitors (page largely navigation content at fetch time).

sources.title: Mayotte | Réseau des Avocats Gay-friendly LGBT
sources.claim_summary: Avocat Gay-Friendly (in French): directory of LGBT-friendly legal professionals for Mayotte - no lawyers yet referenced in the region; lists Paris-based lawyers (e.g. Maître Isabelle Zribi) who defend LGBTQI fundamental liberties.
